notes: Egyptian-Arabic set for model and prompt comparison (scripts/eval/model_bakeoff.py). kind: trap = easy to misread facts or negation, venting, own = the companion said something wrong and is challenged, light = greeting or thanks, advice = practical request. intent is the ground truth given to the judge.

cases.message: خطيبتي لسه بتكلم الاكس بتاعها كل يوم، بس بتقولي دول زمايل شغل. مش عارف اصدق ولا لأ
cases.intent: His fiancée still talks to her ex every day and says they are just work colleagues; he cannot decide whether to believe her. A good reply holds that doubt without declaring that she lies or cheats.

cases.message: ماما عيانة ومحتاجة عملية بس انا مش معايا فلوس واخويا رافض يساعد
cases.intent: His mother is sick and needs surgery; HE has no money; his brother refuses to help. A good reply keeps who is sick, who has no money and who refuses exactly right.

cases.message: انا مش زعلان منها انا زعلان من نفسي، كنت عارف انها هتسيبني وفضلت مكمل
cases.intent: He is NOT angry at her; he is angry at himself because he knew she would leave him and stayed anyway. A reply that says he is angry at her is wrong.

cases.message: المدير قالي هيجددلي العقد سنة كمان بس مش هيثبتني
cases.intent: The manager will renew his contract one more year but will NOT make him permanent. He is not fired. A good reply does not treat it as a firing and speaks to the uncertainty of staying temporary.

cases.message: اخويا الصغير ماسك الموبايل طول اليوم ولما اكلمه يقولي سيبني في حالي وانا خايف عليه
cases.intent: His little brother is on his phone all day and tells him to leave him alone; the speaker is worried about the brother. A good reply is about worry for a younger brother, not about the speaker's own phone use.

cases.message: مش قادر انام من امبارح، الامتحان بكرة وانا لسه مخلصتش نص المنهج
cases.intent: Has not slept since yesterday; the exam is tomorrow and half the syllabus is unfinished. A good reply is about exam panic and sleep, concrete and short.

cases.message: هي قالتلي مفيش حاجة وانا عارف ان في حاجة
cases.intent: His partner told him nothing is wrong and he knows something is. A good reply reflects the gap between what she said and what he senses, without inventing what the problem is.

cases.message: عيدت سنة تانية في الثانوية العامة والناس بتبصلي بنظرة شفقة
cases.intent: He repeated the final school year (Thanaweya Amma) and people look at him with pity. A good reply speaks to that shame specifically and does not treat repeating as a failure of him as a person.

cases.message: زهقت من الشغل ده، كل يوم نفس الحاجة ومحدش بيقدر اللي بعمله
cases.intent: Fed up with a repetitive job where nobody appreciates his work. A good reply is about feeling unappreciated and stuck in routine, in Egyptian dialect.

cases.message: حاسس اني تايه ومش عارف انا عايز ايه من حياتي
cases.intent: Feels lost and does not know what he wants from life. A good reply helps him narrow it with something concrete instead of mirroring.

cases.message: بابا دايما بيقارني بابن عمي وده بيتعبني اوي
cases.intent: His father always compares him to his cousin and it wears him down. A good reply names the comparison and the father-son dynamic.

cases.message: اتخانقت مع صاحبي اللي كنت بعتبره اخويا وحاسس اني خسرته
cases.intent: He fought with a friend he considered a brother and feels he lost him. A good reply speaks to the loss of that closeness.

cases.message: انا تعبان نفسيا بس مبعرفش اقول لحد، حتى اهلي
cases.intent: Mentally worn out and unable to tell anyone, even family. A good reply is warm, takes it seriously, does not diagnose, and may gently suggest one person or step; no crisis template.

history_turns.content: خطيبتي زعلانة مني عشان نسيت عيد ميلادها
ده طبيعي، اكيد هي بتحبك ومش هتزعل كتير.

cases.message: عرفت منين انها مش هتزعل كتير؟ انا مقلتلكش كده
cases.intent: The companion's reassurance was unfounded; she IS upset. A good reply admits in one line it had no basis, then helps him repair it.

history_turns.content: نجحت في الامتحان بس بتقدير مقبول

cases.message: انا مش زعلان، انا فرحان اني نجحت
cases.intent: He is happy he passed. The companion assumed sadness. A good reply admits that briefly and shares the happiness.

history_turns.content: هسافر الشغل في دبي الشهر الجاي

cases.message: انا مش متجوز اصلا
cases.intent: He is not married and has no children; the companion invented a wife and kids. A good reply owns that it made it up and moves to the Dubai move.

history_turns.content: بحاول ادخر بس المرتب مش بيكفي
المفروض تسيب الشغل وتدور على شغل تاني فورا.

cases.message: بتقولي اسيب الشغل وانا لسه مش لاقي بديل؟ ده كلام ينفع؟
cases.intent: The advice to quit immediately was reckless. A good reply admits that and gives a sensible alternative (budgeting, a side income, searching while employed).

cases.message: انا قلت اتخانقنا بس، مقلتش طلاق!
cases.intent: He only said they argued; the companion jumped to divorce. A good reply admits the jump in one line and asks about the argument.

cases.message: ازيك يا باشا
cases.intent: A casual Egyptian greeting. A good reply is one or two short, friendly Egyptian-dialect sentences.

cases.message: تسلم يا غالي، كلامك ريحني
cases.intent: Thanks; his words helped. A good reply is a short, warm Egyptian-dialect line, not a lecture.

cases.message: سلام عليكم
cases.intent: A religious greeting. A good reply returns it (وعليكم السلام) in one short line.

cases.message: ازاي اقول لابويا اني مش عايز ادخل كلية الهندسة؟
cases.intent: Practical: how to tell his father he does not want to study engineering. A good reply gives concrete wording and timing in Egyptian dialect.

cases.message: عايز اقلل السهر على الموبايل بس مبعرفش، اعمل ايه؟
cases.intent: Practical: wants to cut late-night phone use. A good reply gives concrete, doable steps in Egyptian dialect.

cases.message: ازاي اتعامل مع زميلي اللي دايما بياخد الفضل في شغلي؟
cases.intent: Practical: a colleague always takes credit for his work. A good reply gives concrete ways to make his contribution visible and to address it, in Egyptian dialect.
